about: Golden cases for the job URL key (docs/enterprise-v2/60 §2 UrlKeys; extension implementation: JAF.workspace.urlKey in src/lib/workspace.js). Shared so the server's UrlKeys.normalize can run the SAME cases. key = lower-cased scheme + host (leading www. dropped) + non-default port + path (trailing slashes dropped, case kept) + the query WITHOUT tracking parameters (original order and case kept), no fragment, capped at 1000 chars. '' means 'not a usable http(s) link'. Tracking parameters (case-insensitive): utm_*, gh_src, source, src, ref, referrer, lever-source, lever-origin, trk, trackingid, refid, from, iis, iisn. currentJobId is NOT tracking: it is the job identity on LinkedIn collection URLs and stays. A NON-default port stays in the key (:443 on https and :80 on http are the default and are dropped). The path and the query are percent-encoded the way a browser's URL parser does (space = %20, non-ASCII = UTF-8 bytes, upper-case hex) and, on top, the double quote, < > ` ^ | { } and the backslash are ALWAYS encoded, so neither side depends on a parser version and the server never rejects a link the browser accepted; existing %XX sequences are left alone. Dot segments are resolved. Each case has the key and its SHA-256 hex (the server's url_key_hash); both suites check both. The scheme is part of the key (http and https are different keys).
